integrity: The stabilization formula is proved by an exact induction on distance colors and independently checked with a direct tuple-level 2-WL implementation through order 60; a separate arithmetic check covers the closed form through order 4096.
limitations: Finite simple undirected cycles only, under the standard atomic-pair initialization and refinement-round convention. The counting-width statement defines each fixed cycle rather than the class of cycles uniformly.
title: Exact 2-WL stabilization and counting width of cycle graphs
